subject: english
stem: Jay wore a name card and carried three boxes into the food center before it opened. What is likely?
options: Jay was a customer buying food
He owned every box in the center
The center was closing for good
Jay was helping prepare the center

optionRationales.reason: Jay was a customer buying food：尚未 opened 且在搬箱。
He owned every box in the center：every 超出。
The center was closing for good：before it opened 相反。
Jay was helping prepare the center：name card、boxes、before open 共同像工作或志工準備。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「兩項各自不足的明示線索合併後只支持一個結果」可推出 Jay was helping prepare the center；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Jay was helping prepare the center 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
